readme:
# Douyin XingTu KOL Cost Metrics API

Pass a XingTu `kolId` and get the cost-performance estimates XingTu shows for the creator.

## Use cases

- Estimate campaign reach and cost per view.
- Compare cost efficiency across KOLs.
- Support media-buying decisions.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/douyin/xingtu/kol-cp-info-v1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"kolId": "7038603512770461703"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kolId` | string | Yes | User kolId, can be obtained from the following interfaces: `douyin/xingtu/xingtu-kolid-by-uid`; `douyin/xingtu/xingtu-k… |

## Example response

Real response for the request above, trimmed to the main fields. User names and long IDs are masked.

```json
{
  "expect_cpe": {
    "cpe_21_60": "106",
    "cpe_60": "143"
  },
  "expect_cpm": {
    "cpm_21_60": "4415",
    "cpm_60": "5919"
  },
  "expect_vv": {
    "value": 312535
  },
  "hot_item": {
    "value": 1800
  }
}
```

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Douyin XingTu KOL Profile](/model/douyin/xingtu/kol-base-info-v1): Get the XingTu (Douyin creator marketplace) profile of a KOL: followers, location, category tags, online status and available collaboration types.
- [Douyin XingTu KOL Audience](/model/douyin/xingtu/kol-fans-portrait-v1): Get the audience portrait of a Douyin KOL from XingTu: fan age, gender, region, device and interest distributions.
- [Douyin XingTu KOL Price](/model/douyin/xingtu/kol-service-price-v1): Get the XingTu rate card of a Douyin KOL: price per collaboration type (sponsored video, live and more), settlement type and industry tags.
